question: What roles as worshipper, obstacle-remover, and mother define the goddess's relation to the supreme god?
premises: The goddess worships the god of gods.
The goddess is associated with obstacles as their remover or controller.
The goddess is also the mother of the god of gods.
inference: She simultaneously serves, protects, and originates in relation to the supreme god.
uncertainties: vighnā may mean remover of obstacles or one who embodies obstacles; taken here as obstacle-remover.
plain_english: She worships the god of gods, removes obstacles, and is also the mother of the god of gods.
